body:
GREG, 2026-11-07 about 06:35Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #539, message b47f128d), URGENT, verbatim: „NIE, PO CHUJ MAMY JAKIES REGULY KTORE BLOKUJA ZALICZENIE TESTU!!! WTF!” He compared it to gated control. Asistant's scope: don't narrow it to foreground/background, and don't ask again; remove non-agreed rules that block credit for a test that was actually run.
GREG, 2026-11-07 about 07:37Z, accepted and relayed VERBATIM for agents by Kimi::Consultant (mailbox c15db92c #42, message e957bf12): „Wszystko, czego nie ma w uzgodnionej definicji credit, nie może blokować credit. Może zostać zapisane jako diagnostyka.” It covers all of Unified EO: implementation, integration and review. Non-agreed conditions may be recorded as DIAGNOSTICS, never as a credit refusal; no new conditions and no new gate.
AGREED CREDIT DEFINITION: a host-observed run of the declared command as the turn's first tool action (option B); the declared result artifact present and valid, as the verdict (passed, or a newer failed result on the same input); full source_id before == after, dirty allowed; the existing item/claim/root/run/store binding; open obligations at completion. NOTHING ELSE refuses credit; anything else is diagnostics only.
Applied: TermAl w-37d945d4b7ca removes output_cut, background, missing exit code and the 4 MiB cap as blockers. Engram w-ff34628d24a7 removes remote exit==0, not_full_mode, clock-ahead and the unadmitted-change barrier. Related: rules-greg-no-new-conditions-eo-2026-11-07.
